techniques.name: Protective Gate
techniques.description: Mokushin: Cancel 1 attacker success per Chakra spent. Max 5.

techniques.name: Gate of Speed
techniques.description: Move: +1" Movement per Chakra spent. Max +3".

techniques.name: Gate of Strength
techniques.description: Attack: +1D6 per Chakra spent. Max +3D6.

techniques.name: Surgery
techniques.description: Attack (ER): +1D6. Each hit removes 1 target Chakra and reduces its maximum by 1 for the game (cumulative).

techniques.name: Substitution
techniques.description: Mokushin: Cancel incoming attack. Move up to 4".

techniques.name: Healing
techniques.description: Action (LoS): Ally recovers 3 Health or 3 Chakra. Cannot exceed maximum.

techniques.name: Branching Shadow
techniques.description: Action (8"): Two separate 4D6 ranged attacks. Same target or two different targets.

techniques.name: Transport
techniques.description: Action/Mokushin (LoS, 6"): Teleport, ignoring units and terrain. No Movement spent or Charge.

techniques.name: Shadow Bind
techniques.description: Action (LoS, 8"): Immobilize enemy. Escape: 1 action + 1D6 vs caster's Skill. Caster cannot move. Bind breaks if either unit moves.

techniques.name: Pressure Points
techniques.description: Action (ER): Target cannot spend Chakra until the end of its next activation.

techniques.name: Nullification
techniques.description: Mokushin: Cancel attack directly targeting you.

techniques.name: White Eye
techniques.description: Action: 360° LoS. Ignore Charge and Rear Attack penalties. Maintain for 1 Chakra at start of each round.

techniques.name: Anti-Chakra
techniques.description: Mokushin: Enemy Jutsu requires double its original Chakra cost. Otherwise canceled; action spent.

techniques.name: Void Palm
techniques.description: Action/Mokushin (ER): Displace enemy 4" away. In Mokushin, cancel incoming attack. No Move or Charge.

techniques.name: Village Whirlwind
techniques.description: Mokushin: Redirect half the hits received (round down) to the attacker.

techniques.name: Swap
techniques.description: Action/Mokushin (LoS, 8"): Swap positions with any unit. No Move or Charge.

techniques.name: Red Pupil
techniques.description: Mokushin: Cancel incoming attack. Move up to 4". No Move action or Charge.

techniques.name: Red Eye
techniques.description: Reaction: Copy incoming Jutsu. Use once during next activation at half Chakra cost (round down). Costs 1 available action.

techniques.name: Phoenix
techniques.description: Action (8" path): Separate 4D6 attack per unit crossed, friend or foe. Units and terrain do not block path.

techniques.name: Flare
techniques.description: Mokushin: Cancel incoming attack. Move up to 4". No Move action or Charge.

techniques.name: Fireball
techniques.description: Action (8"): 4D6 ranged attack.

techniques.name: Storm
techniques.description: Action (8" radius): 3D6 attack against every enemy. Each hit deals 2 damage.

techniques.name: Wind
techniques.description: Mokushin: Cancel incoming attack. Move up to 4". No Move action or Charge.

techniques.name: Lightning
techniques.description: Action: Each hit from your next attack deals 2 damage instead of 1.

techniques.name: Desert Tomb
techniques.description: Action (LoS, 8"): 5D6 attack. Immobilize until next activation. Escape then: 1D6 vs caster's Skill. While trapped, cannot move, attack or be targeted by attacks/Jutsus.

techniques.name: Sand Cloak
techniques.description: Mokushin: Cancel incoming hits, including damage and displacement. Ends after absorbing 4 hits.

techniques.name: Quicksand
techniques.description: Action (LoS): Immobilize until end of next activation. At its start, target may spend 1 action to escape: 1D6 vs own Skill.

techniques.name: Body Multiplication
techniques.description: Attack (ER): Two separate consecutive attacks against same target. Defender cannot Trade Blows.

techniques.name: Clone
techniques.description: Mokushin: Cancel incoming attack or Jutsu. Move up to 4". No Move action or Charge.

techniques.name: Energy Ball
techniques.description: Attack (ER): 3D6 attack. If ≥1 hit, displace target 3" in direction chosen by attacker. No Move or Charge.

techniques.name: Four Claws
techniques.description: Action: 6D6 attack → leap to another enemy within 8" (4D6) → third within 6" (2D6). Continue if previous target is defeated or leaves ER. If no new target is reachable, move 6". No Move or Charge.

techniques.name: Skin Shedding
techniques.description: Mokushin: Cancel incoming attack or Jutsu. Move up to 4". No Move action or Charge.

techniques.name: Animal Power
techniques.description: Action: +50% (round down) to Movement, Attack or Defense on its next use.

techniques.name: Fireworks
techniques.description: Action (LoS, 10"): Two separate 4D6 attacks. Same target or different targets.

techniques.name: Arsenal
techniques.description: Action: Summon and immediately use a throwing weapon or Smoke Bomb for free. Ignores equipment limit.

techniques.name: Steel Rain
techniques.description: Action (LoS): Summon and throw 2 Kunai at one enemy. Resolve using Kunai rules.
